title: Lafu: choose the mobile experience
question: All three directions keep booking public, guided, and easy to follow. Choose the presentation that feels right for Lawu Fun Tennis Club.

options.label: Club wayfinding
options.thesis: Always show where you are and the one action that takes you toward your class.
options.viewport: Lafu header, a readable date strip, chronological session summaries, and a short next-action guide; admin opens directly to Today and pending reviews.
options.risk: Too much guidance can slow regular players; instructions must become compact after the first booking.

raised.raise: Align times, counts and states consistently, while explaining every state in words.
Keep the booking stage and next step visible without making people interpret a map.
Give the current task unmistakable visual priority over secondary details.
Keep a stable reading order and let longer session details expand deliberately.
Make admin summaries compact through disclosure, with comfortable text and tap targets.

options.label: Community matchday
options.lineage: Contemporary community sports apps; AYO presentation reference
options.thesis: Find a class at a glance, then follow a simple booking flow with clear payment instructions.
options.viewport: Date choices above large session summaries with level, coaches, venue, price and remaining places; the selected session opens a clear booking action and guided flow.
options.risk: This is the familiar sports-app direction; Lafu's identity must come from its real club content and careful booking states.

options.label: Session pass
options.lineage: Scheduled-pass information and persistent change notices
options.thesis: Your booking stays together as an easy-to-read summary with its current status and next action.
options.viewport: A time-led session list above a compact booking summary; after reservation, date, venue, participants, deadline and upload action stay together, while admins review the same facts beside proof.
options.case: Keeps the scheduled booking and changed status easy to understand, though it feels less social than the sports-app direction.
options.risk: Ticket styling could imply instant confirmation; pending verification must be explained explicitly and no check-in barcode is added.

options.label: Emission-line rail
options.thesis: Rank aligned activity signals with precise line treatments.
options.viewport: A dark schedule with aligned signals would need extra plain-language state labels for booking.
options.case: Weak tennis-club identification and harder state decoding for a nontechnical customer.
options.kept: Consistent alignment and visibly distinct states, explained in words.
options.risk: Tiny labels and line-only signals undermine comfortable phone use.

options.label: Transit journey
options.thesis: Keep a booking journey legible as a sequence of named stages.
options.viewport: Normal schedule and booking controls with a persistent stage indicator; no literal transport map.
options.case: Useful orientation, but the transport appearance is less direct than Lafu's club guidance.
options.kept: A visible current stage and one obvious next step.
options.risk: A map metaphor can make a simple booking feel more complicated.

options.label: Star atlas
options.thesis: Give the most relevant session the strongest visual priority.
options.viewport: A standard session list with a strongly emphasized relevant entry, without spatial star navigation.
options.case: The visual source adds no tennis-club identification and requires avoidable decoding.
options.kept: Unmistakable priority for the current task over secondary facts.
options.risk: Astronomical decoration could compete with class availability.

options.label: Lexicon clarity
options.thesis: Keep session facts in a stable order with secondary detail clearly bounded.
options.viewport: A text-led schedule with expandable descriptions; normal controls replace printed-mark conventions.
options.case: Dense reference-page character is a weaker match for quick beginner booking than the proposed directions.
options.kept: A stable reading order and deliberately expandable detail.
options.risk: Reading-heavy entries slow date and availability scanning.

options.label: Compact operations
options.thesis: Expose operational facts efficiently to experienced administrators.
options.viewport: An admin-first summary that would need progressive disclosure and larger type to serve phones.
options.case: Packed modules and tiny text conflict with guided booking for people unfamiliar with technology.
options.kept: Compact admin summaries through disclosure instead of shrinking text.
options.risk: Information density can crowd important actions and touch targets.

canonCard.label: Familiar sports-app standard
canonCard.thesis: Use the expected mobile sports-booking presentation at a high craft level.
canonCard.viewport: Dates, filters and class summaries lead into familiar booking steps, using AYO's app as a presentation benchmark.
canonCard.risk: Very familiar by design; product identity depends on Lafu's actual content and thoughtful details.
